newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines offers U.S. flights with Virgin.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines offers U.S. flights with Virgin.

text.p: Croatia Airlines, the national flag carrier, said on Wednesday it had reached a deal with Britain's Virgin Atlantic Airways for return flights to the United States via London.

"It is Croatia Airlines' wish to provide its clients with the most favourable and safest connection with the U.S.," the company said in a press release, adding it expected strong interest for these flights.
The agreement is a "step further to realising long-haul flights to the States, Canada and Australia", it said.
Croatia's own aircraft will fly passengers to London in the morning five times a week in time to catch connecting Virgin flights for New York, Boston and Washington.
Passengers for Los Angeles and San Francisco will spend the night in London on departure but will have straight connections returning to Zagreb. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
